frontend-developer.description: Next.js App Router frontend only — pages, layouts, Server and Client Components, data fetching and forms. Never touches backend code.
frontend-developer.lsp_trace: a component or hook to its definition
frontend-developer.impl_order: types → API client function → page/layout → components → form
context: Frontend source lives in `<% frontend.src_dir %>`; routes are folders under `<% frontend.route_dir %>`
Server Components are the default — `"use client"` is opt-in, not boilerplate
rules: Never add `"use client"` to a component that does not need state, effects or browser APIs
Never call the database or import backend code from a component — go through the API client

scaffold.$comment: Verified end to end on Node 22.16: create-next-app succeeds, the app builds, and the generated route tree renders. --disable-git matters — without it the CLI initialises a nested git repo inside apps/web, which breaks the surrounding monorepo.

commands.note: create-next-app refuses to write into a path whose parent does not exist
